review.finding: decide_gate's all_generated success branch was checked before the waiver-consumption-failure branch. A PR whose only changed path is a corroborated review-record file (.shipwright/planning/iterate/<run>/reviews.json, itself is_generated_path) can have all_generated=True and needs_review=False at once; if the waiver-consumption step then fails, the all_generated branch matched first and posted success, masking the failure test_failed_waiver_consumption_cannot_post_a_green_gate exists to prevent.
review.suggestion: Reorder the waiver-consumption-failure check before the all_generated short-circuit; add a regression test combining all_generated=True with needs_review=False and waiver_consumed_ok=False.
review.fix: Swapped the two branches in decide_gate (plugins/shipwright-security/scripts/lib/pr_review_gate_verdict.py), documented the reordering rationale in the docstring, and added test_all_generated_waived_pr_with_a_failed_waiver_consumption_still_fails to test_pr_review_gate_verdict.py. Full affected-test run: 57 passed. Lint clean.

other_axes: Security (shell-injection), trust-boundary derivation, architecture, readability, and performance all reviewed clean per the reviewer's report — no other findings.
